title: Nuevas instituciones
goal: Read how new democracies wrote entirely new constitutions -- Brazil's 1988 "Citizen Constitution", Colombia's 1991 charter and Constitutional Court, and Paraguay's 1992 post-Stroessner constitution -- plus the region-wide rise of independent electoral tribunals.

items: State what Brazil's 1988 constitution aimed to guarantee.
Describe what Colombia's 1991 constituent assembly created.
Describe the region-wide rise of electoral tribunals.
Use con miras a to name a forward-looking purpose.
